slices.title: Closed attention state: contract, derivation, thread rows
slices.summary: Adds the closed AttentionState enum and AttentionService in attention.proto, a pure derivation over runs, approvals, plans and run_questions with one post-step enrich in ListThreads, ThreadSummary attention fields 16 to 18, and the flagged GET /v1/attention and POST /v1/threads/:thread_id/seen routes. Unseen is threads.unread from WS17-S7 and MarkThreadSeen is UpdateThreadPresentation with unread false; the migration holds only partial indexes.
slices.needs_external: DEC-11 owner decision (WS16-D1 enum, derivation and typed events; WS16-D8 precedence, including failed versus working) recorded before merge
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -p session-core --bin session-core attention -- --ignored --test-threads=1
cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && pnpm exec vitest run src/shared/api/chat-client.test.ts

slices.title: Attention rail, shared FE vocabulary, tab badge
slices.summary: Adds the shared attention vocabulary and the Waiting, Working and Unseen rail sections above the chat list, a chat.mark_thread_seen action, the tab title and badge count, and the BFF GET /api/v1/attention and POST /api/v1/attention/seen routes. The legacy run-status chip stays in place until S7.
slices.needs_external: Space session agrees the section model (F-t1-009) before merge
test_commands: cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && pnpm exec vitest run src/shared/attention/attention-state.test.ts src/shared/api/attention-client.test.ts src/features/core/lib/attention-badge.test.ts src/features/core/components/CoreSidebar.attention-sections.test.tsx src/features/chat/lib/chat-organization.test.ts src/features/core/components/CoreSidebar.chat-sessions.test.tsx

slices.title: Typed RUN_ATTENTION events from outbox
slices.summary: Adds a session-core sweeper that writes one content-free RUN_ATTENTION outbox row per pending waiting item, with opaque ids only and no row for ZDR runs, published on the existing run-event subject with no ACL, CHECK or provisioner change.
slices.needs_external: WS01-S2 deployed on the running stack (outbox publisher fix, migration 0043); WS13-D10 reconciled with WS13-S3 on the shared run-event subject
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -p session-core --bin session-core attention -- --ignored --test-threads=1

slices.title: Typed notifications: capability-core, notification-core, native delivery
slices.summary: Routes RUN_ATTENTION through the capability-core run-watch consumer into content-free notifications that fail closed on ZDR or a missing zdr flag, adds a channel-aware preference gate so an email-off channel no longer suppresses in-app delivery, and adds a native notification-core adapter for allowlisted types behind a default-off switch.
slices.needs_external: DEC-38 owner decision (WS16-D2 native adapter, WS16-D6 waiting states always notify) before merge; Space shares the one-line allowlist entries (whichever lands first, the other rebases); the running stack's NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_MODE recorded as evidence (not determined)
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/go/services/capability-core" && go test ./... && go vet ./...
cd "apps/Application Plane/notification-core" && go test -v ./... && go build -v ./cmd/server

slices.title: Per-user shell stream
slices.summary: Adds a per-user attention hub in session-core that fans out snapshot, changed, resync and heartbeat frames over an SSE stream that the BFF relays verbatim, with one shared connection per browser profile, and reduces the navbar poll to a 300 second fallback while the stream is unhealthy.
slices.needs_external: DEC-38 D3 confirmed by the Space session before merge (WS16-D3); Application Plane confirms the transport and delivery split (K1-9) before merge; session-core replica count recorded as evidence (not determined)
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -p session-core --bin session-core attention -- --ignored --test-threads=1
cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && pnpm exec vitest run src/shared/api/attention-stream.test.ts src/features/core/lib/attention-store.test.ts

slices.title: Web Push + installable PWA
slices.summary: Adds encrypted Web Push subscriptions, a VAPID sender and the subscription routes in notification-core, the BFF push proxy, and an installable PWA whose service worker handles only push, notificationclick and pushsubscriptionchange with no caching, plus a per-channel notification settings section that replaces the dead push toggle.
slices.needs_external: DEC-38 decisions WS16-D4 (VAPID custody with Application Plane bootstrap keys) and WS16-D5 (no push for ZDR in v1) recorded before merge; web-push library, licence and version to be chosen and recorded (not determined); Safari or iOS verified only if a device is available, otherwise recorded as untested
slices.flag: NOTIFICATION_WEB_PUSH_ENABLED (default false); NOTIFICATION_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY, NOTIFICATION_VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY, NOTIFICATION_VAPID_SUBJECT, NOTIFICATION_PUSH_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY (generated by run-application-plane.sh, never hand-written)
test_commands: cd "apps/Application Plane/notification-core" && go test -v ./... && go build -v ./cmd/server
cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && pnpm exec vitest run src/features/core/lib/push-subscription.test.ts src/features/settings/components/NotificationChannelsSection.test.tsx

slices.summary: Deletes the legacy run-status vocabulary and the fallback-era timers, flips each S1 to S6 flag on in dev compose one at a time after its evidence, records the decisions-ledger entries and matrix rows, and produces one dated evidence bundle covering the S1 to S6 flows.
